summary: Iteration 12 — Backend + Frontend regression pass for email verification gate & Home AI-credit capsule. BACKEND (14/14 pytest PASS, /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_12.py): (1) POST /api/auth/register returns session_token + user.email_verified=false + auth_provider=email; verification email is enqueued (email_verifications row created). (2) GET /api/auth/me exposes email_verified=false. (3) GET /api/auth/verify-email?token=bogus returns HTML 200 with an 'invalid link' message (non-JSON). (4) POST /api/auth/resend-verification returns {ok:true} for BOTH the known-unverified email AND an unknown/random email (non-enumerating). REGRESSIONS: /api/auth/login works, wrong password → 401; /api/auth/forgot-password returns ok for both known & unknown; /api/auth/reset-password with a bogus code returns 400. AI CREDITS: /api/ai/usage returns limit=5/used/remaining/premium=false/unlimited=false; /api/ai/discover consumes exactly +2 credits per call; /api/discoveries (kind=text) consumes exactly +1 credit; a fresh account hits HTTP 402 on the 3rd ai/discover call (5 free credits → 402 detail 'You've reached today's free AI limit'). FRONTEND (mobile 390x844, all target flows PASS): (1) Register a NEW email/password account via /(auth)/register → app auto-redirects to /verify with testID verify-screen (NOT tabs). Verify screen shows: logo, mail icon, title 'Verify your email', body 'Click the verification link we sent to your email to continue.', the user's email, plus Pressables verify-recheck ("I've verified, check again"), verify-resend ("Resend verification email"), verify-logout (Sign out). (2) Tapping verify-resend shows the success toast 'Verification email sent.'. (3) Tapping verify-recheck while still unverified keeps the user on /verify (GET /api/auth/me is called, email_verified still false). (4) After flipping email_verified=true in Mongo (db.users) for the test user and logging in again → app lands on /(tabs) home-screen. home-ai-credits capsule (top-right) reads '✨ 5 / 5 AI credits today' and is tappable → opens /paywall (paywall-screen present). home-lib-count is visible next to 'Your library' title and reads '0 titles'. (5) REGRESSION — bottom tabs Home/Library/Lists/Search/Profile all open without crashing (no ReferenceError/TypeError). Tapping the 's1' suggestion on the Search tab correctly navigates to /ai-discover?q=Movie%20about%20time%20travel and ai-discover-screen mounts.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:233 register() correctly sets email_verified=False on new email/password accounts and calls _send_verification_email; still returns a session_token so the client can render the /verify gate while allowing GET /api/auth/me. Existing users without the field are treated as verified via _to_public() default (True) — backward-compat OK.
backend/server.py:488 resend_verification() short-circuits silently for unknown / non-email / already-verified accounts and returns {ok:true} — properly non-enumerating.
backend/server.py:461 verify_email_link returns HTMLResponse (200) for invalid/expired/valid — matches the review spec of a static HTML success/failure page. Deletes the token row on success.

rca_of_issue: N/A — no bug reproduced. Feature-verification pass. Reproduction script for the email-verification gate: (1) POST /api/auth/register → user.email_verified=false. (2) Frontend AuthGate (app/_layout.tsx:55) sees user.auth_provider==='email' && email_verified===false and router.replace('/(auth)/verify'). (3) Verify screen calls POST /auth/resend-verification (200 ok:true) and GET /auth/me on recheck. (4) After a valid token verification (curl-checked by main agent) OR a manual DB flip, the same AuthGate observes email_verified===true and router.replace('/(tabs)') on next mount.
